claim: When a monitored structured field keeps the same schema but its value changes, the change-type label to record is value_changed.
sub_question: When a monitored structured field keeps the same schema but its value changes, which change-type label should be recorded?
evidence: Diff Output Format defines Change Type as one of field_added, field_removed, value_changed, or structure_changed; a same-schema value update is value_changed.
notes: Schema-stable value updates map to value_changed; structure_changed is for structural/schema diffs.
